newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle trade steady - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle trade steady - USDA.

text.p: Steers and heifers were steady on both a live and dressed basis on Wednesday. Trade was slow to moderate. Demand moderate. Seller interest light to moderate. Offerings current, USDA said.
Steers: Select to mostly Choice 3-4 1175-1300 lbs 66.00-67.00
Heifers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1075-1175 lbs 66.00-67.00
